actions.text: Log. 13:15. Inside the ribcage. The ribs measured nineteen metres last month. Twenty-six now. Every surface is written on in red, and the writing is still being written. A radio crackles somewhere in the vertebrae, receiving only.

rule.name: The Tally Answers
rule.description: Inside the ribs the whale keeps count. Whenever you drive something off, fresh bone (slow ground) grows around you for a while.

actions.reason: The worms add a mark for every wound in this place, and the Fall answers each mark in bone. You can hear it creak when something stops moving.
